subtopics.title: ICC Women's T20 World Cup 2026
subtopics.summary: The 10th edition of the biennial ICC Women's T20 tournament was held from 12 June to 5 July 2026, hosted by the England and Wales Cricket Board across 7 venues. The 12 teams played a round-robin group stage in 2 groups of 6, and the top 2 from each group reached the semi-finals. Australia beat England in the final at Lord's to win its record-extending 7th title.
facts: 10th edition of the biennial ICC Women's T20 International Cricket Tournament
Held 12 June to 5 July 2026; hosted by England and Wales Cricket Board across 7 venues
12 teams played in 2 groups of 6 in a round-robin format
Top 2 from each group advanced to the semi-finals
Final at Lord's Cricket Ground, London: Australia defeated England
Australia won its record-extending 7th title
Shree Charani (India): leading wicket-taker with 14 wickets
Charani set a national record for most wickets by an Indian in a single edition
Beth Mooney (Australia): Player of the Final and Player of the Tournament

subtopics.title: Sports and Youth Milestones
subtopics.summary: The Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports announced that Telangana will host the 8th Khelo India Youth Games in November 2026. Leander Paes was appointed Player Ambassador of the Asian Tennis Federation. Vaibhav Sooryavanshi became India's youngest international cricket debutant at 15 years 99 days.
facts: Telangana to host the 8th Khelo India Youth Games, scheduled for November 2026 (announced by Mansukh Mandaviya's ministry)
7th Khelo India Youth Games were hosted by Bihar in 2025
Maharashtra was overall champion at the 7th KIYG, followed by Haryana and Rajasthan
Leander Paes appointed Player Ambassador of the Asian Tennis Federation to promote grassroots tennis
Paes is India's only tennis player to win an Olympic medal: Bronze in Men's Singles, 1996 Atlanta
Paes honoured with the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award (Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award)
Vaibhav Sooryavanshi: India's youngest international cricket debutant at 15 years 99 days
Sooryavanshi made his senior T20I debut against England at Old Trafford, Manchester
Sooryavanshi broke Shafali Verma's record (15 years 239 days, against South Africa in 2019)

subtopics.title: Policy, Heritage and Observances
subtopics.summary: The Centre released a draft of CAFE-III norms that would tighten fuel-efficiency and CO2 emission standards for passenger vehicles from April 2027. Sushruta, the ancient Indian physician and surgeon, is known as the Father of Surgery, and his bronze statue was unveiled by Scotland's Royal College of Surgeons. July also carries several observances, including the International Day of Cooperatives and World Population Day.
facts: CAFE stands for Corporate Average Fuel Efficiency
CAFE norms were introduced by the Bureau of Energy Efficiency in 2017
Applies to petrol, diesel, CNG, LPG, hybrid and electric passenger vehicles weighing up to 3,500 kg
Draft CAFE-III norms propose stricter fuel-efficiency and CO2 standards for passenger vehicles from April 2027
Sushruta: Father of Surgery and Father of Plastic Surgery; disciple of Dhanvantari
Sushruta authored the Sushruta Samhita; it is part of Ayurveda's Great Trilogy with the Charaka Samhita and Astanga Hridaya
Sushruta's bronze statue was unveiled by Scotland's Royal College of Surgeons
International Day of Cooperatives: 1st Saturday of July; 2026 theme 'Cooperatives for a Peaceful World'
National Statistics Day: 29 June, honouring Prasanta Chandra Mahalanobis; 2026 theme 'Unlocking the Potential of Administrative Data'
World Population Day: 11 July; 2026 theme 'Realizing the Hopes and Aspirations of Young People - Today and for the Future'
